profiles.query: SELECT id,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(props,'$.archetype.username')) FROM anchors WHERE kind='NodeAnchor' AND arch_type='Profile' ORDER BY id

follows.query: SELECT src,dst FROM anchors WHERE kind='EdgeAnchor' AND arch_type='Follow' ORDER BY src,dst

tweets.query: SELECT id,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(props,'$.archetype.seed_id')),JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(props,'$.archetype.content')),JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(props,'$.archetype.author_username')),JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(props,'$.archetype.created_at')),JSON_EXTRACT(props,'$.archetype.likes'),JSON_EXTRACT(props,'$.archetype.comments') FROM anchors WHERE kind='NodeAnchor' AND arch_type='Tweet' ORDER BY id
